The logic is simple and the defaults are consistent.

terms.meaning: a user type that changes the wording used in the app
the first letters of a name, shown in small avatar circles

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Importing the persona type
sections.what: Brings in the list of allowed persona values.
sections.why: Likely reason: the wording functions should only accept known persona values.

sections.name: PersonaLabels
sections.title: Shape of the label set
sections.what: Defines the set of label names that every persona must provide, covering titles, buttons, navigation names and progress labels.
sections.why: Likely reason: every persona must provide the same labels, so screens can use any of them.
sections.watch_out: Adding a label here means every persona's label set must add it too.

sections.name: getPersonaLabels
sections.title: Wording for each persona
sections.what: Returns the label set for the chosen persona. Professional and builder have their own wording, and any other value gets the student wording.
sections.why: Likely reason: each user type sees terms that fit their work, such as deliverables for a student or client milestones for a builder.
sections.watch_out: An unknown persona value shows the student wording without any warning.

sections.name: getUserInitials
sections.title: Making user initials
sections.what: Builds two letter initials from a name: the first letter of the first and last words, or the first two letters of a single word, or ME when there is no name.
sections.why: Likely reason: short initials fit in small avatar circles.
sections.watch_out: Names with particles or titles can produce initials that do not match what the person expects.

sections.name: getUserDisplayName
sections.title: Making a display name
sections.what: Returns the name with spaces trimmed, or the word User when no name is set.
sections.why: Likely reason: screens need a readable name even when the profile is blank.

summary: Supplies the app's wording for each user type (student, professional or builder), and builds short display names and initials.
purpose: Change screen labels so the app fits the user's role.
why: Likely reason: the same screens serve different kinds of users, so the wording changes by persona. Reason not stated beyond that.
how: 1. Returns a full set of label text for the chosen persona, defaulting to student. 2. Builds two letter initials from the first and last words of a name, or the first two letters if the name is one word, or ME if blank. 3. Returns the trimmed name, or the word User when there is none.
inputs: A persona value, and an optional name.
outputs: A label set, the initials text, and the display name text.
risks: Any persona value other than professional or builder silently shows the student wording. Initials use only the first letter of the first and last word, which can look odd for some names.
debug: If the wrong labels appear, check the stored persona value's spelling. If initials look wrong, check the spacing in the stored name.
